title: How to truncate text with an ellipsis
task: Cap long descriptions at N characters, adding "..." only when something was cut.

excel.note: 20 = the cap; 17 = cap minus the 3 ellipsis dots. Adjust both together.

explanation: The IF guard is what makes it polite: short values pass through untouched, and only genuinely long ones get cut to 17 characters plus "..." — so the result never exceeds the 20-character cap and never shows a pointless ellipsis on text that fit anyway. A tidier variant avoids cutting mid-word: =IF(LEN(A2)>20,LEFT(A2,FIND(" ",A2&" ",17))&"...",A2) backs up to a space. Remember this is display text — keep the full value in its own column.
